items.title: Den Item Previewer
items.text: See any den item in your den before you get it, mannequins too. Previews go in your den and your den items bar and work like your own items: drag them, flip them, put them back. Use the new Preview button on your den's item bar, or the Den Item Previewer window. Only you see them, and your real den changes still save normally.

items.title: Keep what you preview
items.text: Clothing you try on and den items you place are kept for each account. Log back in and your outfit is back on and your den is decorated just how you left it. Remove stops keeping one.

items.title: Pictures of every item
items.text: Item Previewer, Den Item Previewer and JR's Try On and Preview windows in the game show a picture of every item, drawn by the game itself. The Item Previewer shows the item you pick big, in the color you choose, with its worth.

items.title: Smarter search and buttons
items.text: Previewer search finds plurals, words in any order and item IDs (“mannequins” finds every mannequin). The den item bar has round Worth and Preview buttons; point at a round JR button to see its name.

items.title: Better item worths
items.text: One-word items like Books and other den betas now show their worth, and Rare Nerd Glasses are valued by tape color.

items.title: Fixes
items.text: No more false “could not be recycled” popup in Recycle Presets. Remove glow takes your glow off. Looping Phantoms from the in-game button no longer crashes the game, and Tiki Trouble gives its pearl prizes when looping. Fixed the “EPERM” in-game features error, profiles wrongly saying they're already open, and Shop Explorer in dens whose owner has capital letters.

items.title: First time: a quick rebuild
items.text: JR rebuilds its in-game features once after this update. Give it a minute or two, then reopen the game.

items.title: JR inside Animal Jam
items.text: JR's tools now live on the game's own screens: worth in your inventory, den and trades, Rooms and Auto Adventures tabs on the World Map, an Auto Advertise button by the chat bar, and JR's settings in the game's Settings window.

items.title: More Sorts
items.text: Click Sort By in your inventory for more ways to sort: value, rares, Diamond and members items, most copies, color and A to Z. The den editor has them too.

items.title: Pick a Color
items.text: Every color the game has in Edit Animal, a color code box, an eyedropper and a full color picker. Turn on True color to see your animal in the exact color you picked (only you see it).

items.title: New sitting poses
items.text: Front, Back and Mirror on the Actions window: sit facing you, facing away, or flip the pose you're in.

items.title: More in the game
items.text: Save Outfit, Try On and Glow in Edit Animal, Art Studio pictures, Streaming mode with a Display Name, F2 screenshots and smoother busy rooms.

items.title: First time: a one-time download
items.text: JR builds its in-game features from your own game file, so the first time you play it downloads about 70 MB of tools (Java and FFDec) and builds in the background. When it says they're ready, close the game and open it again.

items.title: JR for Mac
items.text: JR now runs on Mac, for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. It finds AJ Classic in your Applications folder.

items.title: Mac shortcuts
items.text: On Mac, shortcuts use Cmd: Cmd+K to search, Cmd+1 to Cmd+5 for pages, and Cmd + and Cmd - to zoom.

items.title: Wiki prices in My Shop Templates
items.text: Each item shows its Item Worth Wiki value. Set one price, or every price in a template, to the wiki value in one click.

items.title: Better item values
items.text: Worth checks tell item colors apart using the wiki's own pictures, so Headdresses and other color-sensitive items are valued correctly.

items.title: Sales Log
items.text: My Shop Templates keeps every sale, with totals for today, the last week and all time. Copy it into a spreadsheet in one click.

items.title: Shop Explorer
items.text: Walk into any den and scan every My Shop at once. See everything for sale with wiki values, and spot items priced under the wiki.

items.title: Recycle Tool
items.text: Save presets of items you don't want, like an adventure's junk prizes, and recycle them all in one click, or automatically while you farm. Share presets with friends. Worn, shop and placed items are never touched.

items.title: Outfits
items.text: Save the clothes you're wearing and put them back on in one click.

items.title: Bulk Buy
items.text: Buy one of something in the game, then buy as many more of that exact item and color as you want.

items.title: Recent Rooms
items.text: Every room and den you've been in since logging in. Click one to go back.

items.title: Auto Advertise
items.text: Say your shop ads in chat on a timer, never faster than every 30 seconds.

items.title: Den Shop
items.text: A new plugin to buy dens directly, for Gems or Diamonds.

items.title: Tiki Trouble and Gem Farm
items.text: Adventures can now run Tiki Trouble on your own: leave the host empty. Gem Farm is a new plugin that collects adventure gem prizes on repeat.

items.title: Bitter Sweets is back
items.text: Adventures can claim Bitter Sweets reward goals directly. Tick the goals you want and JR claims just those.

items.title: My Shop fixes
items.text: JR and the game no longer mix up each other's shop replies, and shop stands are found correctly in dens with mannequins.

items.title: Packet Spammer works again
items.text: Add to list and Send now do something again. If a plugin breaks, JR now tells you instead of failing silently.

items.title: Network tab upgrades
items.text: Hide noisy packets, click a packet to see all of it, and right-click to copy it or send it to the Packet Spammer.

items.title: Console
items.text: Press Tab to finish a command name. Your command history is kept between launches.

items.title: Windows remember
items.text: Each profile reopens at the size and spot you left it, with the plugins you had open. Zoom with Ctrl + and Ctrl -, and Ctrl 0 to reset.

items.title: Desktop notifications
items.text: Get a notification when an item sells from your shop while JR is in the background. Turn it off in Settings.

items.title: Report a bug
items.text: Save a bug report from Logs or Settings and drop it in the JR Discord.
